entries.title: Run concepts can remain stable across presentation
entries.summary: A core run concept can be presented from multiple formations, personnel groups and motions while preserving underlying blocking rules. SAGE should separate concept from presentation.

entries.title: Zone and gap families require different rule-level analysis
entries.summary: Inside/outside zone and gap concepts such as power/counter represent distinct blocking/read families. Player evaluation should consider the actual concept and defensive interaction rather than treating all carries as equivalent.

entries.title: RPO structure can put a defender in conflict
entries.summary: RPO designs can preserve a run concept while changing blocking/read responsibility so the quarterback reads a defender and chooses among run/pass answers.
fantasyImplications: May redistribute QB/RB/receiver opportunity relative to a superficially similar called run; predictive effect requires validation.
